svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female-long-epaulet-sleeve-cadet-officer","name":"Women's Class B blue long-sleeve blouse cadet officer epaulet sleeves (overlay, registered to garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female-long; blank grade)","size_in":{"w":24.5174,"h":36.3441},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2451.74,3634.41],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Edge-on strip (0.4 in deep) along the top edge of the garment epaulet strap (the shoulder line), flush with the armhole seam, over the outer 82 % of the strap's length to its tip (the pointed end and the button stay bare), the way the sleeve looks from the front; the full sleeve is the separate top-down asset garment-blues-class-b-epaulet-top-*.
